references.text: Describes the same event where a strong wind stirs up the sea, and the disciples cry out to Jesus in the storm.
Retelling of the same episode with the storm on the Sea of Galilee and the disciples' fear.
Describes sailors encountering huge waves and storms, crying out to the Lord in distress, paralleling the situation of the disciples.
Refers to God's sovereignty over the sea and the storm, a theme emphasized when Jesus later calms the storm.
